Privacy Policy
Elite Octane, LLC (EO) is committed to protecting the confidentiality of any Personal Data you provide to us. We strive to safeguard such data from misuse, loss, unauthorized access, disclosure and alteration. We only collect Personal Data that is relevant to our described purposes. We do not sell or rent any Personal Data.
This Privacy Policy applies to the Personal Data we gather when you utilize the EO website, the EO App or any of our services. This policy does not apply to the privacy practices of any third party that we do not own, control or with whom we are affiliated. Personal Data may include such information as name, mailing address, e-mail address, phone number(s) and payment information.
We may collect Personal Data about you from the following sources:
• Information we receive from you on applications or other forms
• Information from communications we have with you
• Information about your transactions with us
• Information from third parties who provide consumer information or verify consumer relationships.
We use “cookies” to collect information. Cookies are files with a small amount of data that are sent to your browser from a website and are stored on your computer or mobile device. Session cookies are cookies that expire when you close your browser. Persistent cookies remain on your computer hard drive or mobile device for an extended period of time. Persistent cookies may store your login, password or preferences to enhance your experience on our website or app. The help area of most web browser tool bars will explain how to prevent your browser from accepting new cookies, how to command the browser to notify you when you receive a new cookie or how to fully disable cookies. If you disable cookies, you may not be able to use portions of our website or app.
Your browser settings may allow you to automatically transmit a Do Not Track (DNT) signal to websites and on line services you visit. EO does not alter its practices when we receive a DNTsignal from a visitor’s browser.
We may use your personal information only in the areas as described below:
EO Personnel – EO personnel, including EO consultants and/or contractors, may use your Personal Data to provide our services, administer our promotional programs, solicit your feedback, inform you of our products and services or as necessary while carrying out their duties in the normal course of EO business.
Business Transfers -In the event of a sale, merger, reorganization, sale of assets or similar
event, your Personal Data may be part of the transferred assets.
Protection of EO and Others -We may also release Personal Data when required by law, court order, or other government or law enforcement authority or regulatory agency or whenever we believe disclosing Personal Data is necessary to protect the rights, property or safety of EO, our employees, our users or others.
With your consent -We may request permission to share your Personal Data for a specific purpose. We will notify you and request consent before the Personal Data we share your
Personal Data for such purpose.
If you have provided us with Personal Data, you may access, remove, review or make changes by emailing us at grain@eliteoctane.net. Please include Privacy Policy in the subject line. If you prefer to contact us by mail, please contact the Privacy Policy Department at 60502 Glacier Rd. Atlantic, IA 50022. EO has the sole discretion to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Use of information we collect is subject to the Privacy Policy in effect at such time the information is used. If we make changes to the Privacy Policy we will post an announcement on the EO website so you are always aware of what information we collect, how we use this information and under what circumstances, if any, this information might be disclosed.
